title: UniDG: Unified Defect Generation via Defect-Context Editing
abstract: arXiv:2604.08915v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generating realistic visual defects is crucial for alleviating the scarcity of abnormal samples in anomaly detection, yet existing methods often rely on category-specific few-shot adaptation and struggle to generalize across objects, defect types, and domains. This limitation stems in part from the lack of paired defect editing data and the fine-grained nature of defect appearance, where subtle variations in scale, texture, and morphology must be preserved while maintaining consistency with the target scene. To address this challenge, we introduce UDG, a dataset of 300K normal-abnormal-mask-caption quadruplets curated from diverse defect-related scenarios, and present UniDG, a unified defect generation model. UniDG formulates defect synthesis as Defect-Context Editing: it extracts reference defect context with adaptive cropping, organizes reference and target inputs in a structured diptych format, and fuses multimodal condition

translated_title: UniDG：基于缺陷-上下文编辑的统一缺陷生成
translated_abstract: 生成逼真的视觉缺陷对于缓解异常检测中异常样本稀缺的问题至关重要，然而现有方法通常依赖类别特定的少样本自适应，难以在物体、缺陷类型和领域之间泛化。这一局限部分源于配对缺陷编辑数据的缺失，以及缺陷外观的细粒度特性——在保持与目标场景一致性的同时，必须保留尺度、纹理和形态上的细微变化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了UDG，一个从多样化缺陷相关场景中收集整理的、包含30万组正常-异常-掩码-文本描述四元组的数据集，并提出了统一的缺陷生成模型UniDG。UniDG将缺陷合成建模为缺陷-上下文编辑任务：通过自适应裁剪提取参考缺陷上下文，以结构化的双联画格式组织参考输入与目标输入，并融合多模态条件……
tldr: 提出了包含30万组四元组数据的UDG数据集与统一的缺陷生成模型UniDG，将缺陷合成建模为“缺陷-上下文编辑”任务，实现了跨物体、缺陷类型和领域的通用逼真缺陷生成，以缓解异常检测中异常样本稀缺的问题。
en_tdlr: UniDG introduces a 300K-quadruplet dataset (UDG) and a unified defect generation model that frames defect synthesis as Defect-Context Editing, enabling generalizable and realistic defect generation across objects, defect types, and domains to alleviate abnormal sample scarcity in anomaly detection.
